Good setup. Wrong price. You bought PREMIUM. 💸

After an impulse, the upper half of the leg is premium and the lower half is discount. Buying at 90% of the move puts your stop inside the normal retracement, so you get shaken out right before price continues from discount.

1️⃣ Mark the 50% of the leg
2️⃣ Buy only in discount
3️⃣ Sell only in premium
